data.name: Gopalakrishna
data.gender_notes: Gopalakrishna is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Gopalakrishna is a combination of two Sanskrit words - Gopala and Krishna. Gopala means 'Cowherder' and Krishna means 'Black'. Together, this name signifies the divine cowherd, who is also known as the black god. In Hindu mythology, Lord Krishna is often depicted as a cowherd who protects and nurtures the cows in Vrindavan.
data.spiritual_meaning: Gopalakrishna is a spiritual name that represents the divine protector and nurturer. It signifies the presence of God in the form of a caring and loving being. This name is often chanted and revered by devotees of Lord Krishna, who seek his protection and guidance in their lives.
data.etymology: Gopalakrishna belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gopala (cowherder) Krishna (black).”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Gopalakrishna total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

data.cultural_impact: The name Gopalakrishna holds significant cultural significance in Hinduism. It is a tribute to Lord Krishna, one of the most revered deities in Hinduism. Lord Krishna is celebrated as a god-deity with various incarnations and avatars throughout Hindu mythology, each with unique characteristics and significance. The name Gopalakrishna highlights his role as the divine cowherd, emphasizing his compassionate and nurturing nature.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Gopalakrishna represents the supreme divinity, embodied as the cowherd who protects, nurtures, and shepherds his devotees, guiding them on their spiritual journey. The name is a reminder of Lord Krishna's immense love and compassion towards all beings, as indicated by his acts of protecting the cows and his devotees. The name Gopalakrishna is a powerful call to connect with the divine through contemplation, devotion, and selfless service.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Gopalakrishna signifies the embodiment of both Gopala (the cowherd protector and source of all joy) and Krishna (the supreme god and embodiment of divine love and compassion). This name symbolizes the eternal guardian and guide, nurturing and guiding souls towards divine love and ultimate liberation.
